mapper.select: /** TermsOfUseMapper.selectTermsOfUseInUse */ SELECT TOU.id, TOU.orderNumber, TOU.useYn, CASE WHEN useYn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS useYnValue, TOU.isEssential, CASE WHEN isEssential = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS essentialValue, TOU.title, TOU.content_text AS contentText, TOU.content_html AS contentHtml, TOU.content_md AS contentMd, TOU.createMemberId, TOU.createDate FROM TERMS_OF_USE TOU WHERE TOU.useYn = 1 ORDER BY TOU.orderNumber ASC
